chapters.title: Start the campaign
chapters.goal: Start the single-player campaign and get into the first mission.
hints: The main menu is touch-driven: tap Single Player, then the campaign.
Each mission opens with a briefing; the objectives are listed there and in the pause menu.
The pause menu (START) is where you save and where the objectives are repeated.

chapters.title: Learn the controls
chapters.goal: Get comfortable moving the cursor, selecting units and giving orders.
hints: The D-pad pans the map and moves the cursor; A selects and confirms; B cancels.
L and R cycle between your units and buildings.
The touch screen can also select units: tapping a unit selects it, tapping the ground moves it.

chapters.title: Build the economy
chapters.goal: Get villagers gathering food, wood, gold and stone.
hints: Train villagers at the Town Center: they are the units that gather.
Send villagers to the resource they are standing near: trees for wood, bushes and animals for food.
Keep producing villagers while you gather: an idle Town Center is wasted time.

chapters.title: Build an army
chapters.goal: Build a military building, train units and use them for the mission's objective.
hints: A Barracks trains infantry, an Archery Range archers, a Stable cavalry.
Upgrades at the buildings make units stronger for the rest of the mission.
Keep soldiers near the villagers: the mission usually attacks your base.

chapters.title: Finish the mission
chapters.goal: Complete the current mission's objectives and move to the next one.
hints: Read the objectives again in the pause menu when it is unclear what is left.
Save before a big attack: missions are long and losses are permanent in the mission.
The mission ends when the objectives are done, not when the map is empty.
